proofTerm:
by
  intro a b ha hb hgcd r s
  have hg : Int.gcd (a : ℤ) (b : ℤ) = 1 := by
    simpa using hgcd
  let u : ℤ := Int.gcdA (a : ℤ) (b : ℤ)
  let v : ℤ := Int.gcdB (a : ℤ) (b : ℤ)
  have huv : (a : ℤ) * u + (b : ℤ) * v = 1 := by
    have h := Int.gcd_eq_gcd_ab (a : ℤ) (b : ℤ)
    simpa [u, v, hg] using h.symm
  let x : ℤ := r * ((b : ℤ) * v) + s * ((a : ℤ) * u)
  have hx_r : x - r = (a : ℤ) * u * (s - r) := by
    have hbv : (b : ℤ) * v = 1 - (a : ℤ) * u := by linarith
    dsimp [x]
    rw [hbv]
    ring
  have hx_s : x - s = (b : ℤ) * v * (r - s) := by
    have hau : (a : ℤ) * u = 1 - (b : ℤ) * v := by linarith
    dsimp [x]
    rw [hau]
    ring
  have hx_a : (a : ℤ) ∣ x - r := by
    refine ⟨u * (s - r), ?_⟩
    rw [hx_r]
    ring
  have hx_b : (b : ℤ) ∣ x - s := by
    refine ⟨v * (r - s), ?_⟩
    rw [hx_s]
    ring
  refine ⟨x, hx_a, hx_b, ?_⟩
  intro y hy_a hy_b
  have ha_yx : (a : ℤ) ∣ y - x := by
    have hsub : (y - r) - (x - r) = y - x := by ring
    simpa [hsub] using dvd_sub hy_a hx_a
  have hb_yx : (b : ℤ) ∣ y - x := by
    have hsub : (y - s) - (x - s) = y - x := by ring
    simpa [hsub] using dvd_sub hy_b hx_b
  rcases ha_yx with ⟨k, hk⟩
  have hb_ak : (b : ℤ) ∣ (a : ℤ) * k := by
    simpa [hk] using hb_yx
  have hk_decomp : k = ((a : ℤ) * k) * u + (b : ℤ) * (k * v) := by
    calc
      k = k * ((a : ℤ) * u + (b : ℤ) * v) := by
        simp [huv]
      _ = ((a : ℤ) * k) * u + (b : ℤ) * (k * v) := by ring
  have hb_k : (b : ℤ) ∣ k := by
    rw [hk_decomp]
    have h1 : (b : ℤ) ∣ ((a : ℤ) * k) * u := by
      rcases hb_ak with ⟨l, hl⟩
      refine ⟨l * u, ?_⟩
      rw [hl]
      ring
    have h2 : (b : ℤ) ∣ (b : ℤ) * (k * v) := ⟨k * v, rfl⟩
    exact dvd_add h1 h2
  rcases hb_k with ⟨t, hkt⟩
  refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
  rw [hk, hkt]
  ring
